name: fitting-snorkel

references.role: our approved icon from the same family (the diagnose clipboard, picked 11 Nov 2026): match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only; do not copy its shape

art_plan.size: drawn by the game at about 24 to 32 px beside a fitting, tune or part in the fittings window and the Health tab; requested at 1024

prompt:
SMALL GAME ICON. One single object seen from the front, centred, flat on the canvas, like a small icon beside a list entry in a strategy game.

Create an ORIGINAL small game icon for the D'thorga vehicle fitting: a snorkel, a raised engine air intake. Image 1 is our approved icon from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 80 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A vehicle snorkel standing alone: a tall, slightly bent black tube that rises straight up, with a bracket clamp halfway, ending at the top in a chunky forward-facing air ram head with slots.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 32 pixels: one big shape, very few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, vehicles, text, letters, numbers, logos, screens, dust, floor, ground or cast shadow.
